hypothesis: Replacing the 2.0xATR(14) initial stop with 3.0xATR(14), with entries and exits otherwise unchanged, raises in-sample net expectancy per round trip above zero on the 2022-2023 three-name band-eligible universe (HDFC, INFY, RELIANCE), because at a measured daily ATR of 1.96-2.14% the 2.0x stop sits inside routine large-cap noise and converts still-valid swings into realised losses.
rationale: Audit 71.6.1 measurements: daily ATR(14) as a share of close 2022-01-03..2023-12-29 is HDFC 2.14%, INFY 2.08%, RELIANCE 1.96%; of the 47 fresh crossovers on those three names a 2.0xATR stop was touched within 10 sessions 18 times (38%) versus 10 times (21%) at 3.0x; the baseline loss is concentrated in the 2022 chop (20 fills, 10 closed trades, 0 winners) while 2023 earns PF 1.202894 on 5 trades. Round-trip statutory cost at Rs 80,000 notional is Rs 225.90 (0.2824%).

rationale: seq 8, pre-registered before execution under Audit §74.10 Ruling D: k is frozen at 2.0 (the value seq 6 measured), indicators sma_20/sma_50 and every cost, slippage and sizing parameter are unchanged from seq 6, trim is disabled, and the only change is the band policy pre-registered in criteria 1.1.4 — an instrument-session with no attested price band fills unless its bar is locked. hypothesis: Among the qualifying entries on a session, selecting by 63-session cross-sectional rank instead of ISIN order raises per-trade gross expectancy enough to clear the statutory cost schedule (Audit §75.11).
rationale: seq 9, pre-registered in criteria 1.1.5 before execution (Audit §75.10 items 3-4, §75.11): one change against seq 8 — entry_rank_indicator mom_63 (descending 63-session trailing close return, ascending ISIN tie-break). Everything else frozen: sma_20/sma_50, k = 2.0, allocation 0.0800, trim None, LOCKED_BAR_REFUSAL_ONLY, min_entry_notional 25000, min_fill_notional 5000. The prior is weak and is recorded as such: on this corpus the top-minus-bottom quintile spread is +2.25pp at 20 sessions but the median same-session spread is -0.65pp, so the mean is carried by a few explosive days and the typical ranking is inverted. Pre-committed success: net expectancy > 0, gross >= 0.30% of notional per round trip, liquidated PF >= 1.50, MaxDD <= 25%, >= 200 closed round trips, DSR >= 0.95 at N = 9, N_eval = 5. Falsifier: gross below 0.30% with a viable book closes the SMA(20/50) long-only family and the next hypothesis moves to holding horizon, not another entry filter. In-sample only: the 2024 validation fold is frozen and the holdout is not read.

hypothesis: Delivery-swing SMA(20/50) trend-following with the pre-registered mom_63 entry rank earns a positive net expectancy per completed round trip on the point-in-time liquid NSE EQ universe over the expanded in-sample window 2018-04-01..2023-12-31, with the 21-session hold bound enforced where the hold is evaluated (Audit §93.5 Ruling 3).
rationale: seq 10, registered before execution under Audit §93.5 Ruling 3. Configuration is seq 9's committed one — sma_20/sma_50, k = 2.0, allocation 0.0800, trim None, LOCKED_BAR_REFUSAL_ONLY, mom_63, min_entry_notional 25000, min_fill_notional 5000 — with one fact the earlier eight did not have: the engine now consults criteria.max_hold_trading_sessions (21) through Portfolio.require_hold_bounds and routes the exit through the same harness (§92.2, §91.9 item 1). Trials 1-9 were run without an enforced hold bound (§93.4), so they are history and not this row's comparator; the comparator is a current-tree run of this configuration over this window, recorded in reports/verdicts/trial_010/seq10_baseline_comparison.json. The window opens at the criteria' binding start 2018-04-01 (criteria 1.1.15, §91.8) after the 931 warm-up captures were relabelled BINDING_EVALUATION (§92.7 Ruling 1). In-sample only: the 2024 validation fold is frozen and the holdout is not read.
